The socks feature variegated yarns in earth tones (rust, brown, olive green, cream) with distinct color-blocking and striping patterns. One sock stands upright on the right, displaying a ribbed cuff and heel turn. Another lies flat at the bottom left with a pom-pom attached to the toe. Two others are bunched in the background. The texture is visibly coarse and fibrous, consistent with wool.
